content: The 3 INVARIANTS.md lines removed are the 'Emission alone is not execution evidence' paragraph, rewritten in place: it keeps that sentence, keeps shared finite-domain traversal and semantic/consumer qualification as separate work and keeps coax.evidence.v1 as evaluator-only; only the 'bounded native execution remains separate' clause changes, because this commit supplies it, and a new 34-line section adds stricter rules (complete original baseline before emission, matching BEGIN/END plus exit0 to pass, signals nonpassing, a separate execution.v1 record, product authority gates unchanged). The only other removed lines in the commit are 0.40.0 version strings, a README table description and the catalogue count 118->119. coax/tests/run.sh only appends native_check_execution.py and native_execution_transport.py to the existing && chain. Both pass at e49a5a7dae (27/27, 4/4).
